words.sense: Praise a person or thing enthusiastically and in detail
misconceptions: Equating any praise with a rise in rank.
Assuming official elevation is merely a compliment.

words.sense: Raise someone or something to higher dignity, rank, or status
misconceptions: Equating any praise with a rise in rank.
Mistaking audience size for the nature of the act.

semantic_axes.description: Extol means praising qualities enthusiastically; exalt means raising someone or something to a much higher status or dignity.

edges.boundary_rule: Extol means praising qualities enthusiastically; exalt means raising someone or something to a much higher status or dignity.

misconceptions.M1: Equating any praise with a rise in rank.
misconceptions.M2: Assuming official elevation is merely a compliment.
misconceptions.M3: Mistaking audience size for the nature of the act.

chains.frame: Which word best describes what the school does to Kaito?

beats.text: The school places Kaito's portrait above its former champions and names him the model every future athlete should follow.
beats.decisive_clue: elevates him to exceptional symbolic standing
beats.reason: The initial evidence is elevates him to exceptional symbolic standing; it best supports exalt.

beats.text: A new annual prize is created in his name as the highest honour athletes can receive.
beats.decisive_clue: raises his standing into a lasting revered standard
beats.reason: The named prize institutionalizes the higher status already conferred.

chains.feedback_short: The named prize institutionalizes the higher status already conferred.
chains.feedback_deep: Extol means celebrate merits verbally or in writing; exalt means elevate standing or place on a pedestal. The named prize institutionalizes the higher status already conferred.
chains.contrast_rule: Extol tells why someone is excellent; exalt lifts their standing.
